title: fix(rest): GET /forms/:slug reads a .custom pair's own translation of its form view override

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgRuogP8Tp8XyFXLc92Bxvo6)_

Fixes #34806

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:公开表单 `GET /forms/:slug` 翻译表单视图时,补上 `.custom` 配对包自带的译文这一档,与 `/meta/view` 读取同一套标签顺序。
- 为什么改:配对包覆盖了表单的标题或分区标题并自带中文译文时,匿名访客看到的仍是覆盖原文(英文),登录用户在 `/meta` 却看到中文;同一份文档两处答案不同。
- 风险与回滚:只影响「表单视图被配对包覆盖、且配对包为该文案提供了请求语种译文」的公开表单;其余表单输出逐字不变。字段标签(对象那一半)不动。回滚即还原 `form-routes.ts` 一处调用。
- 先看:`packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts`(视图翻译调用处新增的 `pairTranslationBundleOf`);`packages/rest/src/public-form-pair-translation.test.ts`(含 `/meta` 对照腿)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/public-form-pair-translation.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿;其中 zh-CN 用例的表单标题与分区标题为配对包译文。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`GET /forms/:slug` now hands the public form's view translator the `.custom` pair's own translations (`pairBundle`), asked with `pairTranslationBundleOf(p, 'view', match.view)`, the same question the `/meta/view` list and item reads ask (ruling 6995998752: the read half only). The label order is the one already ruled (6631250894 on #30062, restated 6942920667 on #33952) and owned by `@objectstack/spec/system`'s `labelCatalogs`: a translation the pair ships, then the override's own text, then the base's translation. With no pair, or a pair that ships no row for the request's locale, the helper answers `undefined` and the call is exactly what it was.

- Scope per the ruling: the object translate call is unchanged and no pair source is invented for objects. An object is extended, never replaced (ADR-0146 D10), so it never answers `servedOverrideBaseOf`.
- One comment in the object block said "this route passes no `pairBundle`". This change makes that false for the route, so the comment now states the object-specific reason. The code there is untouched.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/**` is not touched. The write-door half is split off by the ruling.

## Tests

New `packages/rest/src/public-form-pair-translation.test.ts`. It uses the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` over a real `SchemaRegistry`. The fixture seeds a container form under the base package, the pair's declared override row (`package_id: BASE.custom`, `overrides.package: BASE`) and the pair's zh-CN `translation` row. Every cell reads both `/forms/:slug` and `GET /meta/view/:name` (the control leg) on the same fixture:

- the matched view carries the envelope (`_packageId` = base, `overrides.package` = base, `servedOverrideBaseOf` answers the base);
- zh-CN with pair translation: the title and the about heading come from the pair on both surfaces. The unchanged description keeps the base's zh-CN translation;
- en (the pair ships none): the override's own text on both surfaces;
- zh-CN, override but no pair translation: the override's own text beats the base translation on both surfaces;
- zh-CN, no override: the base's translation on both surfaces.

Code was last changed at `f62c05f8a0`, and the package runs below are on that tree. The later commits `8a81c3c7dd` (changeset wording) and `8d14c223ba` (one add-only row in `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json`) change no code. The gates that read those files were re-run at `8d14c223ba`.

## Acceptance notes

- The claim placed the pin in a new file beside `public-form-section-i18n.test.ts`. The fixture here is the `/meta` precedence host, not that file's protocol double, so the two do not share a harness.
- Not covered: whether the same pair rank reaches the form's thank-you panel text (`submitBehavior`). The translator reads the same catalogs there, but no test here seeds it.

## Verification

Local subset only. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reports 74 derived, 72 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. CI runs every family, and its check-runs on this PR are the verdict.

- The 72 run families all exited 0. `check:engine-double-contract` first answered exit 1, `RETAINED [findOne]` for the new test's `findOne` double: that is new pinned coverage. The fix was `--write`, which added one row to the ledger, and the re-run exited 0.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (only the rest dependency closure was built, not the whole repo).
- NOT MEASURED: `check:type-check-debt`, timed out at 300 s (a repo-wide re-measure on a shared box).
- `overlap-check --branch=claude/issue-34806-public-form-pair-bundle`: VERDICT clean. It merges cleanly with origin/main and with #34999, which shares the ledger file.
